title: Review of c06's pcell slip-ring negative: replicates on fresh seed 3 (14 cells -> 1-2 domain-filling bodies by t~13500, 0 persistent splits, L rim/core 1.21, 0/8 membrane-like)
summary: Ran the finding's world.py (pcell-yeff-cap plus label-free slip mu=2.2) on seed 3 to t=100000 with labkit (200 frames at 500 steps). Cells form from noise (14 components at frame 0's segmentation, small round cells visible at t=4000), then grow and merge until by t~13500 one or two bodies fill the domain, separated only by thin channels of the outside phase that persist to the end (sheet). labkit: 13 splits, 0 persistent, merge/split 0.77, final 2 components at occupancy 0.17 of the outside channel; L link rim/core 1.21, rim/outside 0.99, 0/8 membrane-like. Same outcome as the finding's seeds 0 and 1.

observations.B: rerun/seed3/FACTS.md: L rim/core 1.21, 0/8 membrane-like, no membrane-like channel; sheet t=13500-100000: domain-filling bodies, no bounded cells

seeds_run.result: slip drive: cells merge into domain-filling bodies, no ring

controls_run.B: the no-slip pcell-efficiency world on another seed (my 20261025T1344-c11-review-pcell-efficiency, seed 7) keeps bounded cells

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; the no-slip twin was not run on the same seed 3.
